summary: Rezolve AI PLC filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing unaudited Q1 2026 revenue of $60 million, exceeding its audited FY2025 revenue of $46.8 million. The release reaffirms $360 million revenue guidance for 2026 and states the company can achieve profitability without raising equity capital. No transaction, shareholder vote, or structural change is involved; the filing is purely a voluntary operational update. The Form 6-K is an SEC filing for foreign private issuers to provide material information, here used to disclose financial performance. This is a routine current report without special-situation characteristics.
